about: Accommodation label space for UNIfy. Derived by reading the accessibility prose in data/clean/evidence.jsonl, not invented up front: every label below is attested in the corpus, and labels appearing at fewer than 3 of 28 schools were dropped as unlearnable at this sample size.
caveats: keyword_estimate_schools is what the keyword baseline finds, NOT ground truth. Real base rates come from the hand-labelled gold set.

Labels marked near_universal are true at (nearly) every school. They are facts about Ontario, not features that can distinguish schools, and a recommender that ranks on them will rank on noise. Keep them for description; exclude them from scoring.

The source prose was paraphrased by whoever compiled the spreadsheet, so phrasing is more normalised than real university web copy. Extraction accuracy here is an upper bound on what the same method would achieve when scraping live sites.

The source sheet's own hand-coded columns are NOT reliable gold. Annotation of 6 peer_support cells found the column marks 'yes' wherever a school has anything peer-adjacent ('Peer note-taking' is note-taking; 'Counsellor Assisted E-Support' is counselling), giving 3 false positives and 0 true positives on the sample. Hand-coded columns are recorded alongside predictions, never used as labels.

Do not tune these seeds against data/gold/gold.csv. The gold set is the test set; fitting the extractor to it makes the reported score meaningless. The error analysis says what a better extractor must handle -- it is not a patch list.

labels.name: Extended time on exams
labels.definition: Additional time granted for tests or examinations.

labels.name: Breaks during exams
labels.definition: Scheduled or as-needed rest breaks during an assessment.

labels.name: Private or quiet exam room
labels.definition: Writing in a separate, private, individual or reduced-distraction space.

labels.name: Assignment deadline extensions
labels.definition: Flexibility on assignment due dates (distinct from exam time).

labels.name: Reduced course load
labels.definition: Studying fewer courses per term while keeping full-time status or funding.

labels.name: Note-taking support
labels.definition: Peer or professional note-takers, or provided lecture notes.

labels.name: Lecture recording
labels.definition: Permission or equipment to record lectures.

labels.name: ASL / sign language interpretation
labels.definition: Sign language interpreters for classes or meetings.

labels.name: Captioning of spoken course content
labels.definition: The institution offers captioning or transcription of spoken course content -- live/CART, or transcription of recorded material. Deliberately phrased as a claim about the service, not about wording: a captioning mention that is not an offer of service (a policy reference, or something the student must arrange themselves) does not count, and a school that describes the service without the word 'real-time' still does.
labels.definition_revised: v2: dropped the requirement that the text say 'real-time'. Under v1 the definition demanded live/CART while the seeds fired on bare 'captioning', so York (Keele)'s 'Support: captioning services' was an extractor positive and an annotator negative.
labels.scoring_caveat: This label carries little evidential weight for the KEYWORD baseline specifically: its seeds are the same captioning words the definition describes, so agreement is close to tautological. It remains a real test for semantic extractors, which can over-fire on neighbouring concepts (ASL interpretation, assistive audio devices).

labels.name: Braille materials
labels.definition: Course materials produced in Braille.

labels.name: Audio format materials
labels.definition: Course materials in audio form.

labels.name: Large print materials
labels.definition: Enlarged-text versions of course materials.

labels.name: Accessible digital formats
labels.definition: Screen-reader-compatible PDFs, e-text and other digital alternates.

labels.name: Assistive technology / adaptive software
labels.definition: Provision, loan or advising on assistive hardware and software.

labels.name: Screen readers
labels.definition: Screen reading software named specifically.

labels.name: Speech-to-text / dictation
labels.definition: Voice recognition or dictation tools.

labels.name: Physically accessible buildings
labels.definition: The institution states that campus buildings or facilities are physically accessible -- either as a general claim ('accessible buildings/entrances/classrooms') or by naming features (ramps, elevators, automatic doors, accessible washrooms). Does NOT include wayfinding or navigation help that makes no claim about physical accessibility.
labels.definition_revised: v2: a general accessibility claim now counts. Under v1 ('ramps, elevators, automatic doors, accessible washrooms') near-identical text was judged both ways.

labels.name: Accessible housing / residence
labels.definition: The institution provides, reserves, or assists students in obtaining accessible or adapted residence. Any of provision, priority allocation, or help arranging it counts. Does NOT include mentions of housing that make no reference to accessibility.
labels.definition_revised: v2: 'help with accessible housing' now counts. v1 ('adapted residence rooms or priority accessible housing') did not say how to treat assistance versus provision.

labels.name: Accessible parking or transit
labels.definition: Accessible parking, campus shuttle or paratransit support. Parking listed among a school's accessible campus facilities counts; a permit scheme need not be named.

labels.name: Personalised accommodation plan
labels.definition: An individualised plan agreed with an advisor.

labels.name: Per-term reactivation required
labels.definition: Accommodations must be renewed or activated each term.

labels.name: Interim accommodation without full documentation
labels.definition: Temporary support available before or without formal diagnosis paperwork.

labels.name: Confidentiality / no diagnosis disclosure
labels.definition: Diagnosis need not be disclosed to instructors; service is confidential.

labels.name: Intake meeting required to register
labels.definition: Registration requires an appointment or intake interview.

labels.name: Individual counselling
labels.definition: One-to-one counselling or therapy.

labels.name: Group counselling or workshops
labels.definition: Group therapy, support groups or wellbeing workshops.

labels.name: Same-day or walk-in counselling
labels.definition: Urgent, drop-in or same-day access to a counsellor.

labels.name: Peer support or mentorship programme
labels.definition: Student-to-student mentoring or peer support programme.
labels.note: The source sheet hand-codes this column 25 yes / 3 no, but annotation of 6 sampled cells judged all 6 negative: the column counts peer note-taking and counselling as mentorship. The column is recorded as `hand_coded_column_value` and excluded from the prediction. True prevalence is likely far below 25/28.

labels.name: 24/7 crisis line
labels.definition: Round-the-clock crisis or helpline access.
labels.note: The hand-coded column is 1 for all 28 schools. Zero variance, and unverified -- treat as descriptive only, not as a label.

labels.name: Transition programme
labels.definition: Structured support for entering students, including orientation programmes and high-school-to-university transition programmes.

labels.name: OSAP disability funding / BSWD
labels.definition: Eligibility guidance for OSAP disability funding or the Bursary for Students with Disabilities.

labels.name: Disability bursaries or scholarships
labels.definition: Institution-specific bursaries, awards or scholarships for disabled students.
